verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Termius can generate Ed25519, ECDSA, RSA, and ML-DSA keys [termius-docs-27] and lets users create and manage passphrase-protected SSH keys synced across devices [termius-docs-12]. Keychain items can be attached to multiple Hosts and Groups for key-based login [termius-docs-3], and existing key files can be imported [termius-docs-16]. Missing for 10: documentation of deploying or exporting the public key to the server (e.g., an authorized_keys install step), and independent hands-on corroboration of the key-generation workflow.
